item.description:
Release v5.7.5

Changes since v5.7.4

  • docs(MessageList): add V1 AgentTurn summaries implementation plan
  • feat(AgentTurnRunner): add turn-level record aggregation from LLM request history
  • feat(Git): register viewContainer and move commit list to rail sidebar
  • feat(LLMProviderDeepSeek): rename protocol files, add render kinds and HTTP 401 renderer
  • feat(LumiKernel): add persisted agent turn records and activity summary enhancements
  • feat(MessageList): project V1 to one row per AgentTurn with legacy fallback
  • feat(MessageManager,AgentTurnRunner): persist message turn identity and aggregate records per page
  • feat(MessageRenderer): display AI reasoning/thinking process in assistant messages
  • feat(RClickPlugin): enable plugin and add rail preview sidebar
  • fix: add minimum height to tool call result popover to prevent it from being too short when content is minimal
  • fix: resolve compiler type-check timeout in AppSplitDivider
  • fix(LumiUI): measure native divider hit area and hide native divider for accurate hover tracking
  • refactor(MessageList): split MessageListView into V1/V2 sub-views by verbosity
